# Pull request

## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Scope

- [ ] Tunnel server or relay
- [ ] Tunnel agent or CLI
- [ ] Protocol
- [ ] Dashboard
- [ ] Desktop app
- [ ] Storage or migrations
- [ ] Documentation or deployment
- [ ] Optional Outpipe integration

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run fmt`
- [ ] Relevant tests run
- [ ] Security implications reviewed
- [ ] Documentation updated
- [ ] No credentials or private tunnel data included

## Deployment notes

Describe migrations, configuration changes, protocol changes, or rollout requirements.
